title: Numerical monomial
statement: For a subset $S$ of the $n$ coordinates and a binary vector $x\in(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n$, define its numerical monomial to be $1$ if every coordinate in $S$ equals $1$, and $0$ otherwise; equivalently, it is the product over $i\in S$ of the indicator that $x_i=1$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite subset $S$ of the $n$ coordinates
